title: Los Angeles County Heat Action Plan Data Viewer Webinar
description:
Learn how to use the Los Angeles County Heat Action Plan (CHAP) Data Viewer to support heat resilience planning, grant applications, and project development. The LA County Chief Sustainability Office hosted this webinar in collaboration with the LA County Internal Services Department and the UCLA Luskin Center for Innovation on June 22, 2026. 

The webinar provides an overview of the CHAP Data Viewer, an interactive mapping tool that combines data on heat-related health burden, social vulnerability, community conditions and assets, and site-level heat data to help local governments, community-based organizations, and other practitioners better understand heat risk and identify potential resilience strategies.

To access the CHAP Data Viewer and related resources, visit: https://cso.lacounty.gov/ourcounty-plan/cso-current-initiatives/county-heat-action-plan/
